title: Pan-Seared Crisp Fish with Sashimi Salad
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared fish served with a refreshing sashimi salad.

ingredients.name: Australian Fish
ingredients.notes: Choose a firm variety such as snapper or barramundi

ingredients.name: Sashimi-Grade Fish
ingredients.notes: Choose a mild variety such as salmon or tuna

instructions: 1. Rinse the Australian fish under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
2. Season the fish with salt and pepper.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
4. Add a small amount of oil to the pan and swirl to coat.
5. Sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
6. Remove the fish from the pan and set aside to rest.
7. In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, soy sauce, and grated ginger.
8. Add the sliced cucumber, carrots, and avocado to the bowl and toss to combine.
9. Slice the sashimi-grade fish into thin pieces and add to the bowl.
11. Serve the pan-seared fish with the sashimi salad.
